messages:
Jules: That all-hands finale tho — can we have a mini-mascot parade in the hallway? :parrot: :confetti_ball:
Maya: YES PLEASE. I will bring a kazoo and a tiny flag. who's with me? :v:
Sam: Microwaved applause? someone start the microwave ovation. :laughing: :thumbsup:
Rina: I promise no socks this time, just legitimately questionable leftover chili. :eyes:
ops-bot: Reminder: Please label food in the fridge and remove after 48h — facilities policy. (automated)
Theo: https://giphy.com/gifs/marching-mascot — mood. :rofl:
Jules: love that gif. can we get it projected on the big screen during the parade? :tv:
Maya: also quick poll — cupcakes or mini empanadas for the mascot snack table? vote with emoji :cupcake: or :taco:
Sam: :cupcake: (but i will eat an empanada too)
Rina: :taco: — spicy empanadas for the win
Jules: tally: cupcakes 1, empanadas 1, undecided chaos 3. looks fair. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Theo: can we make a tiny mascot hat? crafting party at 4pm near the coffee station. :scissors: :hatched_chick:
Maya: i'll bring glitter glue. apologies in advance. :sweat_smile:
ops-bot: Note: craft supplies must be used responsibly. Cleanup volunteers needed.
Sam: i'll stay for cleanup if someone saves me an empanada. :raised_hands:
Jules: deal. parade at 4:30, snack table 4:15, tiny hats mandatory. see y'all there! :tada:
